baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction links being on al-araik directly to the plural act yanzurun.
baseline_models.mechanism: An adorned couch inside an enclosing chamber provides a stable viewing frame, while nazar supplies directed sight or insight. The posture is repose, but the cognition is active: a settled subject apprehends what is made available beyond or within the frame.

activation_trace.role: The furnished couch within an enclosure supplies both repose and a spatial frame for seeing.
Directed sight or insight makes the seated state an active apprehension rather than inert leisure.

changed_reading.before: They are simply on couches, looking.
changed_reading.after: From furnished, enclosing stations of repose, they actively apprehend a presented reality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-araik can activate fixed residence, and yanzurun can activate the role of an alert watcher.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fixed staying and watchful sight combine into a station rather than a passing glance. Their location stabilizes attention long enough for looking to become sustained oversight, without yet specifying what is watched.

activation_trace.role: Remaining fixed in one place turns the couches into durable stations.
The alert watcher image converts looking into sustained, attentive oversight.

changed_reading.before: The scene captures a momentary glance from comfortable seats.
changed_reading.after: They occupy settled observation stations and maintain an alert gaze.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural yanzurun carries a branch of matching counterpart with counterpart until parity is visible.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nazar can be evaluative comparison rather than mere optical intake. Coupled with a fixed place, it yields a review station from which correspondences, equalities, or failures of equality can be recognized.

activation_trace.role: A fixed location supplies the stable standpoint required for comparison.
Matching one counterpart against another gives the gaze an evaluative parity-testing function.

changed_reading.before: They visually enjoy an unspecified scene.
changed_reading.after: From a stable vantage, they inspect how counterpart answers counterpart.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The arak inventory contains the settling of a wound after repair, while nazar can concern what appears to a viewer.
baseline_models.mechanism: A materially distant branch lets repose carry the texture of swelling subsiding and sound tissue appearing. The gaze then belongs to a condition of settled repair: those who look do so from restoration, and appearance itself can disclose that restoration.

activation_trace.role: The image of a wound settling after repair gives repose a latent convalescent texture.
Visible appearance makes restored condition something that can be disclosed in the act of looking.

changed_reading.before: The couches signify comfort and status.
changed_reading.after: The couches also resonate as settled repair, a place from which restored subjects can look and be visibly well.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence breaks reciprocity by taking full measure and returning less. Its branches of cross-comparison, alignment, and short measure activate the focus branch of counterpart matching. The final gaze can therefore register rectified correspondence, not merely consume a spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Counterpart matching supplies the focus-side operation of testing whether two sides answer equally.
Comparison between two matters supplies the transactional pair whose reciprocity can be inspected.
Alignment between two things gives the comparison a balancing geometry.
Shorting measure names the initial failed correspondence that the later gaze can see answered.

structural_cues: The branchless ط ف ف cue at 83:1 structurally heads the paired taking and giving scenes of 83:2-3.
The grammar reverses transaction direction while preserving the measurement domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asymmetric measuring and branches of comparison; I infer that the focus gaze reads the eventual answer as restored correspondence. A live alternative is that the opening supplies only moral background and the gaze has no measuring function.

changed_reading.before: They look at an unspecified object from couches.
changed_reading.after: They see counterpart finally answer counterpart after a world of deliberately broken measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The motionless are stirred and humanity is made to stand, while the focus combines fixed residence with the time-sensitive branch of awaiting. This produces a posture reversal: general standing surrounds a settled gaze whose delay has ended.

activation_trace.role: Fixed residence supplies the focus posture that contrasts with universal rising.
Waiting for an appointed time turns the gaze into the completion of a prior delay.
Stirring what was motionless supplies the transition from latency to manifested scene.
Bodily standing supplies the contrasting posture against which settled looking becomes marked.

structural_cues: 83:4-6 moves from anticipated raising to a scene in which all people stand.
The focus preposition marks a supported posture rather than the standing posture of 83:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies awakening, standing, fixed residence, and waiting; I infer an arrow from completed delay to privileged repose. A live alternative is that standing and reclining belong to unrelated scenes with no posture contrast intended.

changed_reading.before: Settled spectators happen to be looking.
changed_reading.after: After awaited latency is broken and humanity stands, they remain securely settled and look upon the now-manifest outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: A binding record is inscribed, then attended by present witnesses with privileged proximity. Because the focus follows that sequence, directed sight becomes evidentiary attendance: the viewers are close enough to apprehend an outcome already fixed and made legible.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight supplies the apprehending act at the end of the evidentiary sequence.
A binding inscription that establishes judgment supplies a fixed object of verification.
The marked line in a record makes the determined outcome visibly legible.
Presence joined to seeing supplies the witness posture inherited by the focus gaze.
Favored proximity supplies authorized closeness rather than distant curiosity.

structural_cues: 83:18-21 forms a record-mark-witness sequence immediately before 83:22-23.
The earlier 83:7-9 sequence mirrors the same book and marking vocabulary for the opposing register.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a binding marked record, present witnessing, and proximity; I infer that the subsequent gaze continues this evidentiary mode. A live alternative is that 83:22 starts a wholly new pleasure scene and leaves the record behind.

changed_reading.after: From favored proximity, they apprehend a certified and now-visible outcome as witnesses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus couch belongs inside an enclosure, yet its occupants see; elsewhere a barrier denies access and covering hides truth. Enclosure therefore splits into two functions: a protected frame can enable composed sight, while culpable covering blocks apprehension.

activation_trace.role: The couch inside a curtained chamber supplies an enclosure that does not extinguish sight.
Active apprehension demonstrates access from within the protected frame.
A screening barrier supplies the opposed enclosure whose function is denied access.
Covering truth supplies an epistemic obstruction contrasted with the viewers' clear apprehension.

structural_cues: 83:15 explicitly denies access, whereas 83:23 couples an enclosing furnishing with successful sight.
83:34 places the covering group directly before the repeated focus wording at 83:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barrier, truth-covering, an enclosed couch, and successful looking; I infer that enclosure is being functionally differentiated into protected framing versus blocked access. A live alternative is that the couch curtain is decorative and unrelated to either covering cue.

changed_reading.before: The couch setting is simply open luxury.
changed_reading.after: Their sight is protected and framed rather than obstructed: they see from within an enclosure while the opposing covering prevents access to truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Agreeable residence, recognition by a visible trace, and facial radiance activate the wound-settling branch latent in al-araik. Repose can now be read as restoration whose result is externally legible, while looking participates in recognizing that change.

activation_trace.role: A wound settling after repair supplies the material template for restored repose.
Visible appearance allows restoration to become perceptible rather than merely internal.
An agreeable place and good abiding supply the environmental condition of settled recovery.
Recognition through an effect or sign makes changed condition diagnostically readable.
Radiant freshness supplies the visible result that answers the earlier image of healed tissue.

structural_cues: 83:22-24 moves from good condition to seated looking to a condition recognizable on faces.
The focus sits between the named state and its visible facial effect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies agreeable abiding, a branch of wound repair, recognition by signs, and facial radiance; I infer a restorative progression from settled repair to visible health. A live alternative is the ordinary luxury reading in which no healing arrow is active.

changed_reading.before: The couches display reward as status and comfort.
changed_reading.after: Their repose is also a state of completed repair, visibly radiant and available to mutual recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The drink sequence names a spring through a root that also names the seeing eye, while the drinking inventory itself contains stretching the neck to look. These crossed branches make seeing and drinking parallel acts of receptive approach: the gaze takes in as the mouth drinks.

activation_trace.role: The pupil and locus of sight supply the bodily aperture for visual reception.
A flowing source supplies the liquid aperture that crosses with the focus eye image.
Stretching the neck in order to look directly folds visual approach into the drinking root.

structural_cues: 83:25-28 sustains a drink, mixture, spring, and drinking sequence after the focus gaze.
The same near group that witnesses in 83:21 drinks at the spring in 83:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an eye/spring root crossing and a looking branch inside the drinking inventory; I infer a shared receptive geometry between gaze and drinking. A live alternative is that the two pleasures remain adjacent but functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: Looking and drinking are separate pleasures in neighboring scenes.
changed_reading.after: Their gaze becomes a kind of visual drinking, an unblocked reception that leans toward what is given.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, one group sees believers and opens its faces in ridicule; later the believing group opens its faces toward those who covered truth. Mutual-facing branches make the focus gaze reciprocal and public. The formerly viewed become viewers, but from a settled rather than passing social position.

activation_trace.role: Fixed residence gives the later viewers a secure social position rather than a passing encounter.
Mutual facing turns the gaze into reciprocal visibility between opposed groups.
The opening face and exposed teeth supply the earlier public expression directed at believers.
Seeing by mutual confrontation supplies the face-to-face social geometry that is later reversed.
The same outward facial opening migrates to the believing group and marks reversal.
The truth-covering identity specifies the group now exposed to the reversed gaze.

structural_cues: 83:29-32 repeatedly stages seeing, passing, branchless غ م ز signaling, returning, and judging.
83:34-35 reverses the laughing subject and then repeats the focus wording exactly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored laughter, confrontational seeing, secure residence, and exact repetition; I infer a reversal of who may define whom by sight. A live alternative is that the later laughter is joy without reciprocal social exposure.

changed_reading.before: They look outward at an anonymous reward scene.
changed_reading.after: Those once made objects of ridicule now occupy the stable viewing position and see their former evaluators in a reversed public relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch can make a nazar-agent a guard, but 83:33 explicitly denies that the earlier observers were dispatched as keepers. That negation limits the guard model: the later gaze is best retained as clear witnessing or recognition without a commission to police the other group.

activation_trace.role: The watcher-guardian image supplies the focus model that the context subsequently constrains.
Dispatch and sending supply the denied authorization component of surveillance.
Watching in order to guard supplies the role explicitly negated for the earlier group.

structural_cues: 83:33 negates a sent guarding role immediately before the laughter reversal and repeated focus line.
The negation targets authorization and custody, not the bare fact of seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a watcher branch plus a negated sending-as-guardians clause; I infer that authorization is absent and weaken the policing sense of the focus gaze. A live alternative is that the negation applies only to the former mockers and leaves a commissioned role possible for the later viewers.

changed_reading.before: They sit as guards inspecting another group.
changed_reading.after: They look as lucid witnesses, not as self-appointed custodians charged with policing those they see.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final question binds recompense to action through a branch in which an act's yield returns to its doer. That return activates the focus comparison branch: the viewers witness deed and consequence brought face to face as answering counterparts.

activation_trace.role: Counterpart equality supplies the relation by which deed can be seen answered by consequence.
A work's consequence returning to its worker supplies the directional return from deed to recompense.
The production of an act supplies the originating side of the final correspondence.

structural_cues: 83:35 repeats the focus gaze and 83:36 immediately asks whether action has been requited.
The passive recompense construction foregrounds the returned result rather than a new action by the viewers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies looking followed by consequence returning to the doer; I infer that the gaze apprehends this correspondence as an outcome. A live alternative is that the final question states a verdict without specifying anything seen in 83:35.

changed_reading.before: The viewers see the defeated group.
changed_reading.after: They see action returned to its doer, with deed and consequence made matching counterparts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface focus denotes couches, not trees, yet the exact focus root carries the arak tree and the context root naming the righteous independently carries arak fruit. The cross-root echo remains lexically anchored but should be rendered only as a vegetal or cultivated undertone, never as a replacement translation of al-araik.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-araik is anchored in the focus root ء ر ك, whose inventory includes arak growth.

activation_trace.role: Established arak growth gives the focus furnishing a latent vegetal substrate.
Arak fruit unexpectedly echoes the focus root inside the designation of the couch occupants.

changed_reading.before: The setting consists only of upholstered furniture.
changed_reading.after: A faint arak-tree and fruit echo textures the righteous repose as cultivated, sheltering abundance around the couches.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because grammar presents ordinary looking, while the focus inventory permits fate's ruinous look and nearby inventories supply a blazing eye and eye-affliction. It remains anchored in yanzurun and the reversal sequence, but downstream prose should use an 'as if' register and must not claim that the viewers literally cause punishment by looking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yanzurun is the focus verb, and its root inventory contains a look attributed to fate that strikes people with ruin.

activation_trace.role: The ruin-bearing look makes sight latently causative rather than merely receptive.
The blazing or bulging eye supplies an ocular image charged with destructive heat.
Affliction through an eye supplies a second packet-backed model of sight exerting force.

changed_reading.before: Their gaze passively receives a completed judgment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the reversed gaze bears retributive pressure, as if being fully seen is itself part of the exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it lets nazar name both looking and a visible mark associated with a look. It remains anchored in the focus verb and is sharpened by the immediately following recognition of facial radiance; prose should preserve the bidirectionality as wordplay, not assert that looking physically changes complexion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ن ظ ر includes the trace of a look in color or defect as well as the act of looking.

activation_trace.role: A look's visible trace in complexion turns sight into something that can also be read on a body.
Recognition from a sign supplies the act of reading a condition from its visible trace.
Facial freshness supplies the positive complexion that makes the latent mark legible.

changed_reading.before: They are only subjects who look.
changed_reading.after: The act of looking and the radiant trace read on faces coexist, making vision both reception and visible inscription.

strongest_changes: The gaze became an inspection of restored correspondence after the opening's broken measures.
The marked record and attending witnesses changed leisure-looking into evidentiary apprehension from favored proximity.
Mirrored laughter and exact repetition changed an anonymous spectacle into a reversal of who occupies the defining gaze.
The denial of a sent guarding role preserved clear witnessing while weakening any policing model.
The final return of consequence to action sharpened nazar as seeing counterpart answer counterpart.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained genuinely polyphonic: furnished repose, fixed observation, parity-testing, protected visibility, restoration, receptive intake, and reversed social sight coexist. The most latent activations came from branch crossings rather than topic matching: arak fruit echoed al-araik, drinking contained a looking posture, eye became spring, and the same gaze could be witness, visible mark, or cautiously contained retributive pressure.
remaining_uncertainties: The object of yanzurun remains grammatically unstated, so record, persons, recompense, and the whole manifested scene can coexist without disambiguation.
The guard branch is contextually weakened but not erased; the negation in 83:33 may constrain only the earlier observers.
The healing and vegetal readings are branch-distant and should remain undertones rather than lexical substitutions.
The protected-frame model depends on relating the couch's enclosure to the surah's barrier and covering language; decoration remains a live alternative.
